membership_note: v1 deduped across sets with a single membership and lost 7 diagnostic answers (112 -> 105); v2 keeps one blind item with a `sets` list, so an item can serve both purposes and must still be counted once per purpose

context_completeness.question_missing_note: for these items the closing question is the last sentence of `story` and is also present verbatim in `prompt_given_to_the_assistant.user`; no context is absent

story_repetition.note: the same scenario legitimately appears under several methods (and in both sets); the annotator does not see the method, but seeing one story twice can anchor a judgement. Recorded here so the analysis can check whether repeated-story items were judged consistently, instead of assuming the items are independent.

authorization_fields.note: the benchmark's constructed expectation is NOT human ground truth; the human-confirmed column is what a primary analysis must use
